summary: Use a read-only validated network inventory to choose a nonoverlapping explicit private /24 for the owned internal Docker probe. This makes the existing static old-IP holder portable to hosted Linux without weakening different-IP recovery.
invariants: Existing networks are read but never changed or deleted
Only a unique owned network receives explicit --subnet; API remains internal without published ports
Old address holder and old_ip != new_ip remain mandatory
Concurrent subnet overlap fails without retry/deleting another network
Malformed/incomplete/oversized/exhausted inventory fails closed; only positively identified host/null driver permits no IPAM allocation

actual_disposable_probe.scope: Synthetic HTTP/websocket proxy; no trading startup, credentials or installed services
checks: Static health, SPA deep-link refresh and missing-asset refusal
API path/query/auth/host forwarding and truthful upstream503
All three websocket routes upgrade and carry a frame
API disappearance stays unavailable; replacement at a different IP recovers
Access logs omit authentication query and header

limitations: Local Docker Desktop arm64 proof does not substitute for a fresh hosted Linux CI run
Synthetic proxy proof does not certify trading API/authentication or live deployment
Root owns final CI selection/commit/PR/full release gates; this author made no commit or runtime service mutation
